title: SOS
lifeThreat: If there is a threat to life, call emergency services now.
noPhones: Phone numbers appear after the app has connected once. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

types.heading: What do you need?
types.childcare: No one to leave the child with
types.item: Urgently need an item or medicine

form.heading: Describe what you need
form.label: Short message
form.hint: Up to 300 characters. Goes to moderators and your confirmed trusted contacts.
form.childcareNote: This request goes only to moderators and your trusted contacts, never to the district feed.

feelBad.heading: Talk to a person
feelBad.description: A psychologist on duty will contact you as soon as possible.

status.raised: SOS sent. Moderators and your trusted contacts were notified.
status.rateLimited: Too many SOS requests. Wait a little and try again.
status.failed: Could not send the SOS. Check your connection or call a number above.
status.queued: No connection. Your request to a person on duty is saved and will be sent automatically.
status.sentHelp: Request sent. A person on duty will contact you.
status.signedOut: Sign in to send an SOS or contact a person on duty. The phone numbers above work without signing in.

open.heading: Your open SOS
open.emptyDescription: When you raise an SOS, it appears here until you close it.
